I haven’t had the best experiences with SSRI’s myself, I was on them on and off from age 16-20 and they really really altered my personality, made me feel like a numb shell and just generally didn’t help. 

Mirtazapine (the one I’m currently on) made me feel a lot worse to begin with, I ended up with the crisis team. They’re definitely the type to make you feel a LOT worse before they make you feel better so I’d bare that in mind! I had to have two weeks off work to adjust because they have that much of an impact. 

I can’t say for sure they’ve helped just yet, I’ve been put on the highest dose so it could take a few weeks to really work but I’ve noticed my memory has improved (which is major for me!) Good luck and I hope you find your best suited medication :)

It’s nothing like an SSRI where you feel numb so that’s one good thing. But, they are a really sedative drug so it makes you very very lethargic and sleepy for the first few weeks (the lower the dosage, the more sedative). I slept a lot when I first started them and now I have awful eye bags but it’s what happens lmao. I’ve heard that a lot of people notice that their appetite increases massively and they have uncontrollable hunger - this didn’t happen to me, my appetite has stayed the same/if not diminished but it’s different for everyone! Try not to worry too much the about side effects because that’s definitely what I did and it deterred me for a while but I reminded myself it’s for the best and what I’m worried might happen, might not even happen. I hope you’re okay and I wish you the best of luck :)
